lessons.title: Mastering Java with Spring Boot: Intermediate to Advanced
lessons.description: In this comprehensive lesson, we will delve deeper into Java and Spring Boot. Starting with advanced Java concepts, including generics, streams, and functional programming, we will then explore in-depth Spring Boot features such as dependency injection, configuration management, and reactive programming. By the end of this lesson, you will be proficient in building robust and scalable Spring Boot applications.

lessons.title: Mastering Advanced Java and Spring Boot with ELobrado
lessons.description: In this comprehensive lesson, we will explore advanced Java and Spring Boot concepts, including dependency injection, configuration management, and Spring Boot's auto-configuration feature. We will also delve into Spring Boot's security features and database integration. By the end of this lesson, you will be proficient in creating complex applications and optimizing your Spring Boot applications for efficiency and performance.

lessons.title: Mastering Java with Spring Boot: Advanced Project Development
lessons.description: In this advanced lesson, we will focus on building a comprehensive and professional Java application using Spring Boot. Starting from a detailed design phase, we will progress through the entire development process, including unit and integration testing. We will also cover performance optimization techniques. By the end of this lesson, you will be equipped to create a robust and maintainable Java application, ready for deployment in a professional environment.
